message.content:
FADE IN:

EXT. LAKESIDE - DAY

A man wades into the shimmering shallows, his boots sinking into cold mud. He grips a tangled net and yanks free a silver trout, its scales catching the dimming light. The fish thrashes, gasping, its gills flaring in the thin air. The man steadies the creature with both hands, tilting its head upward toward the sky, where the moon has swallowed the sun, leaving only a thin ring of fire.

The trout's wide, glassy eyes reflect the corona — a halo of white and violet stretching across the darkened heavens. The man whispers, "Look, little one. Look at it." The fish's mouth opens and closes in rhythm, a silent prayer to a god it cannot name.

FADE TO BLACK.
